text:
Zoe (PM): quick sync — I'm proposing a tight Q3 pilot for 'Cost Sherpa' (batching hints, KV-prefix caching, quant suggestions, eval-alert plumbing). want minimal scope to ship to 2 pilots.
Hector (Eng): short list of infra we need: prefix-cache read API, tiny batching coordinator, safe-quant pipeline hook. keep APIs minimal.
June (ML): concordance check is non-negotiable. nightly job that flags >2% semantic drift. will provide a simple script we can run in CI.
Ari (Solutions): SEs need a one-page ROI helper. CSV with tokens/session, sessions/day, cost/token, expected_pct_save should be enough for demos.
Zoe (PM): proposed pilot slice (minimal): Console shows read-only recs + single-click batching preset; ROI CSV for SEs; nightly concordance alerts to Console/Sentry. Acceptance: feature-flag rollout, <1 extra api call when recs on, concordance job running.
Noah (ProdOps): checklist: telemetry (apply-rate, uptake), SLI (batch-latency p95), rollback runbook, security tag if pilot tenant is enterprise.
Hector (Eng): tiny example batching policy for effort calc:
```
batch_policy:
  name: minimal_window
  max_wait_ms: 60
  max_batch_tokens: 1500
```
June (ML): concordance pseudo: 
```
orig = run_on(val_set)
quant = run_quant(val_set)
if semantic_similarity(orig, quant) < 98.0:
  emit_alert('quant-concordance')
```
Ari (Solutions): I'll prepare two vignettes (Shoply, AcmeHealth) and fill the CSV with sample numbers. good to show SEs during pilot outreach.
Zoe (PM): prioritization ask: we can deliver two Q3 items. my pick: 1) pilot slice described above (fast customer value), 2) landing prefix-cache infra + small batch coordinator. enterprise controls later. objections?
Hector (Eng): 👍 but mark prefix-cache + safe-quant path as cross-cutting blockers in the stories. I'll spike the prefix-cache today.
June (ML): I'll contribute the nightly harness and a short doc on how to interpret concordance diffs.
Noah (ProdOps): adding JIRA checklist right now. will tag security for enterprise pilot tenants.
notify-bot: created OPT-999 Cost Sherpa pilot scope (owner: Zoe)
Zoe (PM): action items: Zoe — finalize CSV + one-pager (EOD Thu); Hector — prefix-cache spike & batch proto (PR by Tue); June — concordance harness draft (Wed); Ari — SE one-pager + vignettes (Wed); Noah — JIRA checklist + security tags (today).
Ari (Solutions): also recommend default alert thresholds conservative to limit noise. advanced controls for power users.
Hector (Eng): will surface infra blockers by Mon if any.
June (ML): adding short examples to the eval harness tomorrow.
Zoe (PM): final launch line for messaging: "Cost Sherpa: safely cut inference cost with explainable recommendations." keep it concise.
Ari (Solutions): love it. :rocket:
